dialect.detail: CCVS-74 (COBOL Compiler Validation System, Version 4.0, 1980) test suite program from the US General Services Administration Federal Compiler Testing Center. Uses COMMUNICATION SECTION with CD entries, RECEIVE/SEND/ENABLE verbs typical of COBOL-74 inter-program communication features.

purpose.domain_detail: COBOL compiler validation suite (CCVS-74) testing COMMUNICATION SECTION features including RECEIVE, SEND, ENABLE verbs and message queuing
purpose.summary: This is a CCVS-74 compiler validation test program (CM201M) that tests COBOL COMMUNICATION SECTION functionality. It receives messages from an input queue, sends acknowledgement messages back to an output queue, and handles the case where no data is available. It is part of the US GSA Federal Compiler Testing Center's standard COBOL validation suite.

notable_features: COMMUNICATION SECTION with CD entries (rare feature)
SEND ... WITH EMI/EGI (End of Message Indicator / End of Group Indicator)
XXXXX placeholder tokens for site-specific values (CCVS convention)
Sequence numbers in columns 1-6 with program-id suffix in columns 73-80
verdict.notes: The XXXXX032, XXXXX033, XXXXX082, XXXXX083 tokens are CCVS placeholder substitution variables to be replaced with site-specific values before compilation. The *> tokens in PIC clauses (lines 005100, 005500) appear to be inline comments or corruption artifacts. The sequence numbers in columns 73-80 follow the CCVS convention of appending the program ID and version. This is a well-known public domain compiler validation suite.
